items.q: First time I saw Garvin Bushell, he came to Chicago with Lucille Hegamin.

ctx.x: Well, then it was -- almost always he had Garvin Bushell in the band.
Garvin's a fine musician, Garvin Bushell. First time I saw Garvin Bushell, he came to Chicago with Lucille Hegamin.
